references.text: David expresses a similar desire to understand and see God's wonders, reflecting the longing for God's revelation.
Isaiah speaks of things no one has seen or heard, which God has prepared for those who wait for him, mirroring the longing to experience God's kingdom.
Jeremiah expresses a wish to see days of righteousness, which can be viewed as a longing to witness the time of the Messiah.
This verse highlights the privilege of Jesus' disciples, who get to see and hear what many righteous people and prophets longed for.
The author of Hebrews speaks about heroes of faith who died without receiving what was promised, reflecting the longing to see God's promises fulfilled.
